statement: GST registration is compulsory when taxable turnover exceeds S$1 million at the end of the calendar year (apply within 30 days of the year end, with registration effective the first day of March) or when taxable turnover is reasonably expected to exceed S$1 million in the next 12 months (apply within 30 days of the forecast date, with registration 2 months from that date for liability arising on or after 1 July 2025).
caveat: Taxable turnover counts standard-rated and zero-rated supplies and excludes exempt and out-of-scope supplies and capital-asset sales. Voluntary registration, the reverse-charge regime and overseas-vendor registration carry their own rules; check IRAS's registration calculator and live guidance before relying.
